description: Portable multi-agent network that discovers free public APIs, calls them live from the caller's browser, and verifies claims against fetched data. Load via agent-manifest.json (network: open_api_scout, front agent: scout_coordinator). Runs on the caller's own LLM router and key.
name: Open API Scout

skills.description: Recommend free no-key public APIs for a goal from a published directory.
skills.name: Public API discovery

skills.description: Fetch live JSON from allowlisted public APIs and summarize it with citations.
skills.name: Live public-data analysis
